title: Social Control: Formal and Informal
plain: The police and courts direct their attention disproportionately at working-class crime (street theft, disorder, benefit fraud) while largely ignoring or under-penalising the harmful acts of the powerful (corporate crime, tax avoidance, financial fraud).
